items.title: ZDI-26-785: FreeBSD Kernel Shared Memory Time-Of-Check Time-Of-Use Local Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
items.summary: This vulnerability allows local attackers to escalate privileges on affected installations of FreeBSD Kernel. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target system in order to exploit this vulnerability. The ZDI has assigned a CVSS rating of 7.8. The following CVEs are assigned: CVE-2026-58094.
